Workflow.title: A week of my work, running.
Workflow.subtitle: A live Make-style scenario. Run it once, drag the modules, hover for the inspector, watch the bundles travel.
Workflow.body: This is the kind of flow I build every week: a CRM event comes in, a router splits it, each branch talks to a different tool — documents, enrichment, notifications, a data mirror — and an error handler makes sure a failed bundle becomes a message instead of a silent gap. Make and n8n for the orchestration, Python and Supabase when a flow needs real code or a real database.

About.title: About Me
About.quote: Passion fuels purpose. Every line of code is a step toward transforming ideas into impactful solutions.
About.intro: I'm Sambatra Andriamihaja, a Growth Engineer and Full-Stack Developer based in Antananarivo. I hold a Master's in AI & Big Data from ESTIA and spent five years shipping web and mobile platforms — for a telecom, an e-commerce group and a mobile product — before turning to automation: Make scenarios, Python enrichment APIs, Supabase data mirrors and AI agents that let business teams move faster. I like the seams between systems. That is where most software breaks, and where the interesting work is.

points.0: AI data enrichment — designed and built internal Python APIs that enrich CRM records automatically (contact, email, waterfall phone, company and tech-stack enrichment), with Brevo's Data team.
points.1: Cross-platform automation — Make scenarios that synchronise the Brevo CRM in real time with PandaDoc, Planhat, Qobra, Gong, Chili Piper, Slack notifications and other business integrations.
points.2: Mirror database on Supabase — set up and maintain a mirror of the Brevo CRM to work around missing native API filters; it feeds the internal platforms and reduces Make credit consumption.
points.3: Internal platforms — took part in designing the platforms that host the APIs, centralising enrichment and automation tooling while keeping operating costs down.
points.4: Business AI agents on Dust — designed and deployed custom agents so Brevo teams can query the CRM and third-party tools in natural language.

points.0: Updated Mozar's landing page and shipped the new features and sections the team needed — a four-month mission through Valano Tech.
Maintained and extended the Orizon mobile application with a small product team.
points.1: Shipped matching features on the web platform, keeping the GraphQL layer in step across both clients.

points.0: Built web applications in Elixir and Phoenix, including an e-commerce platform for a client on Réunion Island.
points.1: Rebuilt the internal project-monitoring tool and wrote Odoo modules for barcodes and print templates.

points.0: End-of-studies internship for the Orange Summer Challenge 2022 (tech4good): a Flutter app that talks to a biogas production kit, reads its sensors and predicts when the tank runs dry.
Bachelor's internship rebuilding the document-management application used by Telma's Information Systems department.
